title: Area against width for 100 m of fencing
caption: With the wall as one side, the area is A = x(100 − 2x). The curve peaks where dA/dx = 100 − 4x = 0, at x = 25 m (so y = 50 m), giving the maximum area 1250 m².
alt: A downward parabola A = x(100 − 2x) for x from 0 to 50 with its maximum 1250 at x = 25 marked.
description: Two sides of width x and one of length y use 2x + y = 100 m of fence, so y = 100 − 2x.
At the top of the curve dA/dx = 100 − 4x = 0, so x = 25 and y = 50.

checks.name: the maximum area is 1250 m² at x = 25
